source_title: Herdr mod: Atuin threads for the shown space, resumed in a new tab on click - GitHub
source_excerpt:
A panel for the Herdr app that lists the coding-agent sessions Atuin captured as threads, and resumes one in a new tab when clicked.
Install: copy mods/atuin-threads/ into ~/.config/herdr-app/mods/ , merge keys.json into yours, press cmd-shift-t . Needs atuin 18.24.3 or later with threads turned on ( atuin config enable threads ). RECIPE.md is the brief to build it from scratch.
Herdr mod: Atuin threads for the shown space, resumed in a new tab on click
